name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audit any website for the problems that hurt its AI discoverability (getting found and cited by AI assistants) and its on-site engagement (keeping visitors once they arrive), and emit a single prioritized report of findings plus suggested actions.

runtime.notes: Standard library only. No third-party packages, no model weights, no network services beyond read-only HTTP(S) to the audited site.

skills.summary: Receives the audit request, crawls a robots-respecting page sample once, invokes every other skill's checks over that sample, and composes their findings into one report against the fixed schema.
Can the crawler get in and read the page? robots.txt (incl. AI-assistant bots), HTTP status, noindex/canonical, sitemap, and client-side-render gaps.
Is the key fact machine-quotable? Presence and validity of JSON-LD / microdata / RDFa and entity identity (Organization/WebSite, Product, Article).
Are facts stated in readable text? Titles, meta, headings, image alt / text-in-images, language, and PDF-locked content.
Is the fact current and agreed upon elsewhere? Stale dates, undated content, sameAs corroboration, external presence, and entity disambiguation.
Will the visitor stay? Mobile viewport, clear CTA, navigation/orientation, page weight and response time, readability, and breadcrumbs.
